method: walk out/_next/static; zlib.gzipSync(level=9); the chunk whose source contains WebGLRenderer is counted as the 3D chunk, everything else as initial JS
note: The first draft's 150 KB initial / 220 KB 3D caps were estimates; measured Next 16 + React 19 + motion baseline and three.js exceed them. Revised budgets: 250 / 260 KB. The 2026-11-08 rebuild is slightly smaller than the 2026-11-06 measurement because the auto-rotating token was removed and the scene now renders on demand.
